references.text: Judah asks Onan to go in to his brother's wife and fulfill the levirate duty to raise up offspring for his brother - this is the earliest biblical precursor to levirate marriage described in Deuteronomy 25:6
Boaz redeems Ruth and marries her to maintain the deceased's name on his inheritance, a practical application of the levirate marriage law
The women give the child a name and say that a son has been born to Naomi, showing how the firstborn is reckoned to the name of the deceased relative
The Sadducees refer directly to the levirate marriage law when they ask Jesus about the resurrection and the woman who had been married to seven brothers
Mark's parallel account of the Sadducees' question quoting the levirate marriage law from Moses
Luke's version of the Sadducees' question which directly refers to the law that a brother shall raise up offspring for his deceased brother
